The model is consistently about 0.3-0.5 higher than true values in the near term, and the gap widens in the longer horizons.

Looking at Example 4 (2025-05-29):
Model forecast (first 10 days): [70.87, 70.30, 70.68, 72.32, 72.19, 72.15, 72.83, 73.67, 72.37, 74.10]
True outcome (first 10 days): [70.94, 70.41, 70.91, 72.60, 72.61, 72.74, 73.50, 74.23, 72.66, 74.36]


I notice the model's near-term forecasts are slightly below true values, creating an interesting inversion of the previous pattern. The divergence appears to be around 0.1-0.6, with longer-term forecasts showing more significant deviations.
